Since January 2026 Premium 91 has ranged from QAR 1.80 in February to 2.05 in July; it was cut from 2.00 to 1.95 in October and every grade was held for November. Super 95 has stayed at 2.10 since May and diesel at 2.05 since March. We update the table with each monthly announcement.

How to work out your fuel cost

Full tank = tank size × price a litre. Monthly cost = (distance a month × litres per 100 km ÷ 100) × price a litre. A car that covers 2,000 km a month at 8 litres per 100 km needs 160 litres, which is QAR 312 with Premium 91 in November 2026, or QAR 3,744 a year.

How Qatar compares

A litre of 95 costs QAR 2.10 in Qatar, AED 4.04 in the UAE in November 2026 (UAE prices), SAR 2.33 in Saudi Arabia (Saudi prices) and 239 baisa in Oman (Oman prices).

Frequently asked questions

What are petrol prices in Qatar for November 2026?

Premium 91 is QAR 1.95 a litre, Super 95 QAR 2.10 and diesel QAR 2.05, the same as October.

When are Qatar fuel prices announced?

QatarEnergy announces them on the last day of each month and they apply from the 1st of the next month; Qatar News Agency (QNA) publishes them.

How much does a 60-litre tank cost in Qatar?

QAR 117 with Premium 91, QAR 126 with Super 95 and QAR 123 with diesel at November 2026 prices.

Is there VAT on petrol in Qatar?

Qatar has not introduced VAT, so the announced price is what you pay at the pump.
